question: Ayushman Bharat Programme is an umbrella of ________ scheme launched in 2018.
solution:
The correct answer is __**health**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Ayushman Bharat Programme is an umbrella of health schemes launched in 2018.
 
• It aims to address health issues at all levels - primary, secondary, and tertiary care systems.
 
• The programme includes two major health initiatives: Health and Wellness Centers (HWCs) and Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY).
